headline: Last session: Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028 as Nifty reclaimed 25,000.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Sensex surged 1,718 points in the last trading session to close at 81,028, with Nifty rising above 25,000.
Strong buying momentum across financial, auto, and banking stocks fueled consecutive multi-thousand point rallies.
Indian equities bucked a global technology market downturn to log their best weekly gains in six years.
Nifty 50 concluded Samvat 2082 on a highly positive note by reclaiming the 25,000 level.
whatHappening: On November 6, Sensex jumped 1,718 points to settle at 81,028 while Nifty 50 closed at 25,030.
On November 5, Sensex soared over 2,000 points and Nifty topped 24,500 led by financials and autos.
Bank and auto indices posted strong gains of up to 4% during the recent sessions.
Indian stock markets outperformed global peers, recording their strongest weekly performance in six years.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian stock market indices rallied strongly with Sensex surging 1,718 points to close at 81,028 while Nifty 50 reclaimed 25,030. The benchmark indices extended gains powered by solid momentum in banking, financial, and auto stocks. Bucking a broader global tech selloff, Indian equities delivered their best weekly performance in six years.
